import json, subprocess, sys, time
def run(data):
    if isinstance(data, dict): data = json.dumps(data).encode()
    t0=time.time()
    p = subprocess.run([sys.executable,"-I","submission/main.py"], input=data, capture_output=True)
    return p.returncode, p.stdout.decode(), time.time()-t0

# --- exact 2 MiB boundary
base = {"version":1,"n":2,"capacity":[1,1],
        "edges":[{"u":0,"v":1,"ping_us":1,"ack_us":1,"label":"a"}],
        "rounds":[{"launch_us":0,"timeout_us":5,"host_delay_us":1,
                   "drop_host_ack":False,"drop_ping":[],"drop_ack":[]}]}
body = json.dumps(base).encode()
padlen = 2097152 - len(body)
big = b" "*padlen + body
print("exact size", len(big), "rc", run(big)[0])
for extra in (1, 2, 100):
    rc,_,_ = run(b" "*padlen + body + b" "*extra)
    print("size", len(big)+extra, "rc", rc, "(expect 2)")

# --- edges/rounds count boundaries
def many_edges(k):
    # n=96 gives 96*95/2=4560 possible pairs
    pairs=[(u,v) for u in range(96) for v in range(u+1,96)][:k]
    return {"version":1,"n":96,"capacity":[0]*96,
            "edges":[{"u":u,"v":v,"ping_us":1,"ack_us":1,"label":"a"} for u,v in pairs],
            "rounds":[]}
print("edges 384 rc", run(many_edges(384))[0], "(expect 0)")
print("edges 385 rc", run(many_edges(385))[0], "(expect 2)")

def many_rounds(k):
    return {"version":1,"n":2,"capacity":[1,1],
            "edges":[{"u":0,"v":1,"ping_us":1,"ack_us":1,"label":"a"}],
            "rounds":[{"launch_us":0,"timeout_us":1,"host_delay_us":1,"drop_host_ack":True,
                       "drop_ping":[],"drop_ack":[]} for _ in range(k)]}
print("rounds 48 rc", run(many_rounds(48))[0], "(expect 0)")
print("rounds 49 rc", run(many_rounds(49))[0], "(expect 2)")

# --- 8193 paths
def layered(width, layers):
    n = 2 + width*layers
    edges=[]
    def e(u,v): edges.append({"u":u,"v":v,"ping_us":1,"ack_us":1,"label":"x"})
    for k in range(width): e(0,1+k)
    for L in range(layers-1):
        b=1+L*width; nx=1+(L+1)*width
        for a in range(width):
            for b2 in range(width): e(b+a, nx+b2)
    last=1+(layers-1)*width
    for k in range(width): e(last+k, n-1)
    return n, edges
n,e = layered(2,13)
print("8192 paths rc", run({"version":1,"n":n,"capacity":[1]*n,"edges":e,"rounds":[]})[0], "(expect 0)")
